The word "buy" is mentioned two or more times in 0.0% of neuroscience papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "buy" , 35.4% of significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) – i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a lower than the typical neuroscience paper (median shown for reference). Relative to other words, "buy" papers are in the top 55th percentile in terms of fragile p-value percentage (lower = better). Note, p-values highly predict replicability (see the associated paper).
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "buy" tend to be published in lower impact factor journals (12nd percentile among all words) but tend to be cited more (93rd percentile word).
